facts.business: Sanchay Finvest Limited is a listed company with no banking or housing finance activities, and not a Core Investment Company.

auditor.name: M/s Jain Jagawat Kamdar & Co., Chartered Accountants (FRN No. 122530W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on unpaid preference share dividends, NSE penalty and outstanding dues, inadequate confirmation/reconciliation system, and MSME classification without audit evidence; Qualified opinion due to inability to determine impact of unconfirmed balances and unsupported MSME classification.

key_risks: Non-payment of preference share dividends and non-redemption of preference shares
NSE penalties and interest for non-compliances (₹47.88 lakhs)
Outstanding dues to NSE (₹28.39 lakhs) including delayed payments
Inadequate system for confirmation and reconciliation of balances
MSME classification of trade payables based solely on management assessment without audit evidence
No internal audit system established during the year
Cash losses of ₹144.05 lakhs in FY 2025-26 and ₹25.37 lakhs in FY 2024-25
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act and disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
